newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Adsteam sells unit to Devine.
newsitem.headline: Adsteam sells unit to Devine.

text.p: The Adelaide Steamship Co Ltd said on Wednesday that its Pioneer Housing Group Ltd subsidiary had sold its contract housing division to Devine Ltd.
Adsteam did not reveal a sale price.
It said Pioneer would retain its major projects and development divisions, which would continue to focus on their core business of developing major urban renewal and residential community projects.
These included the 1,000 home development in the Melbourne suburb of Kensington, a joint venture with the Victorian government, it said.
Devine, a Brisbane-based residential builder, said in a separate statement that its net cash outlay would be in the order of A$2 million to A$3 million.
"Assets acquired under the deal mainly comprise land and buildings and include A$6 million of Pioneer display centres and display homes and A$1.2 million of developed land," it said.
